provenance: Proposed seed specification for a fresh, dedicated synthetic Zoho Books test organisation (Kāma Coffee (Test)). Contains no real Zoho IDs or customer data. Do NOT apply to any production Zoho organisation.

customer_payments.notes: Included once in cash balance (+300) and reduces FT-INV-1005 balance from 300 to 0. Do not create a separate manual bank deposit or payment will be counted twice.
Partial deposit on FT-INV-1003: included once in cash balance (+80) and reduces FT-INV-1003 balance from 180 to 100.

sales_receipts.notes: Represents completed stall cash-up for 2026-10-22 (cashed_up: true). Included once in acct-cash-main (+80).

expenses.description: Rainhill Supplies: Initial jute sack and label roll stock (synthetic seed)

post_scenario_books_mutations.operation: Record customer payment FT-PAY-2003 of GBP 240.00 on 2026-10-29 against FT-INV-1001 deposited to acct-cash-main.
Owner approves Rainhill Supplies receipt (RHS-SYNTH-2041, GBP 48.60, 2026-10-29) -> POST /books/v3/expenses.
post_scenario_books_mutations.builder_note: Current providers.mjs:186 posts {account_id: EXPENSE_ACCOUNT_ID, date, amount, description, reference_number} without paid_through_account_id. Cash account balance stays unchanged unless paid_through_account_id is set to CASH_ACCOUNT_ID (which would reduce cash by GBP 48.60).

post_scenario_books_mutations.operation: Owner approves stall cash-up ('Sold six 250g bags of lot 2, 60 pounds cash') -> POST /books/v3/salesreceipts.
post_scenario_books_mutations.builder_note: Current providers.mjs:212 posts salesreceipt without deposit_to_account_id. Configure Zoho Books default cash sales deposit account to CASH_ACCOUNT_ID (or pass deposit_to_account_id) if Where I stand cash is expected to rise immediately by +GBP 120.00 rather than landing in Undeposited Funds.
